hero.title: What is Yty?
hero.subtitle: Yty is the force that keeps Sogverse, School of Gaming’s gaming universe, in balance. By doing good things, learning new skills, making friends, behaving well and taking part in the community, gamers earn Yty for the shared pool and for themselves.

overview.heading: How Yty works
overview.paragraph1: Every gamer starts at zero Yty-Points. From every lesson, every Quest completed and every act of kindness, gamers earn Yty-Points. The points build up across the Four Yty-Elements, each one a different side of growing as a person.
overview.paragraph2: As gamers collect Yty for themselves, they also grow the Yty of the whole community. That is how they shape the shared story and open up new possibilities for everyone.

elements.heading: The Four Yty-Elements
elements.subheading: Each Yty-Element is one relationship a gamer is growing: with themselves, with others, with the world and with technology

harmony.name: Harmony
harmony.detail: Who am I? Harmony is about accepting yourself as you are, strengths and weaknesses alike. It means getting to know yourself, looking after your wellbeing, expressing your feelings, making good decisions, and understanding why rules and trust matter.

glow.name: Glow
glow.detail: How can I help others? How can I be a good friend? Glow is about empathy, kindness and building meaningful relationships. It means respecting differences, giving others space, communicating well, and being the kind of person who lifts people up.

valor.name: Valor
valor.detail: How can I make a difference? Valor is about finding your place in the world around you and having the courage to take part in it. It means teamwork, voicing your ideas, using your imagination, and working towards a better future, close to home and across the globe.

wit.name: Wit
wit.detail: How do I use technology well? Wit is a healthy, critical relationship with games, media, AI and the tools around them. It means taking good online behaviour to heart, understanding what new technologies do, thinking critically about information, and finding a balance between screen time and the rest of life.

earning.heading: How gamers earn Yty
earning.paragraph1: Yty-Points are earned by taking an active part in what we do. Weekly lessons, completed Quests, kindness to others, community events and camps all build a gamer’s Yty.
earning.paragraph2: When enough points build up under an Achievement Badge, the badge rises on the gamer’s profile, all the way to diamond. Every Yty-Point also adds to the gamer’s overall Yty-Level and to the Yty-Element it belongs to.
earning.paragraph3: Gedus, parents and the whole community can add to the Yty of Sogverse too, through events and shared activities.
